items.q: What do you build before an outbound campaign?
items.a: Skill groups, user profiles, users, contact fields, lists, dispositions, and campaign profiles. Then the campaign.

items.q: Which builds add IVR scripts on the planning roadmap?
items.a: Inbound and autodial.

items.q: What is a Five9 domain?
items.a: The tenant boundary. Lists and skills do not leak into the next domain.

items.q: Does Five9 use CUCM partitions?
items.a: Not in the admin model this lab cites. The boundary is the domain. Mapping partitions to anything is a teaching bridge.

items.q: Who can be in a skill group?
items.a: Users with the agent or supervisor role. A user can be in more than one skill, and a campaign can have more than one skill.

items.q: How many campaign profiles can a campaign use at once?
items.a: One. A profile can still be reused by several campaigns. Assign it in Advanced mode.

items.q: What can a campaign profile override?
items.a: Defaults such as the ANI. Workflow rules can swap the profile.

items.q: What happens if an inbound campaign is stopped?
items.a: It does not answer. Callers can hear busy.

items.q: Name the three campaign types.
items.a: Inbound, outbound, and autodial. Blended is how you staff, not a fourth type.

items.q: What is list penetration?
items.a: The default walk: the first number on every record, then the next.

items.q: What is vertical list dialing?
items.a: The dialer finishes the numbers on one record before it moves on.

items.q: What does a final disposition do to the other numbers on a record?
items.a: It stops them for that campaign.

items.q: Name the dialing modes on the product pages.
items.a: Preview, progressive, power, predictive, and manual touch.

items.q: How does the outbound page describe progressive?
items.a: One customer call per available agent.

items.q: Why will you not state a numeric abandon default?
items.a: The defaults page warns if Max Abandoned Call Percentage changes. It does not give this lab a percent worth repeating.

items.q: What abandon windows does the defaults page describe?
items.a: A US rolling 30 days and a UK window of 24 hours, set with a Five9 representative.

items.q: What does TCPA manual touch block?
items.a: Paste and drag. The agent types the external number. Dial enables when it matches. Preview timeout sets Not Ready and does not auto-dial.

items.q: Which permission allows skipping records in TCPA manual touch?
items.a: User Can Skip Contact Records in TCPA Manual Touch.

items.q: Name four IVR modules.
items.a: Play, Menu, If/Else, and Skill Transfer are in the modules chapter, among others.

items.q: Where does a Skill Transfer with no skill go?
items.a: The community article says the Default queue.

items.q: Are call variables historical?
items.a: No. Enable reporting before the calls you need. Apply to All Dispositions skips custom dispositions.

items.q: Who can run standard reports?
items.a: A user with the Reporting role and at least one reporting permission.

items.q: Why is a matrix a bad CSV?
items.a: The reporting article treats matrix as a layout, not a direct CSV export.

items.q: How long is the call log, per the July 2026 article?
items.a: About 60 days unless retention is extended. Audio follows a different clock.

items.q: How long does the retention page keep VCC audio?
items.a: The sooner of 30 days, a successful SFTP or FTP offload, or the contract.

items.q: How long are DIDs kept after a domain closes?
items.a: 90 days. A disabled domain itself is 120 days after closure.

items.q: Name two API families without guessing SOAP versus REST.
items.a: Reporting Web Services and Statistics Web Services. The overview also says REST. The transport per family stays unconfirmed here.

items.q: What is the default codec?
items.a: G.711, described as uncompressed. DNS SRV is preferred for SIP targets.

items.q: Which TLS versions matter?
items.a: TLS 1.2 is required. TLS 1.1 is not supported. TLS 1.3 inbound ciphers are listed.

items.q: Is satellite a supported agent path?
items.a: No. Cellular and 5G are not supported either. One-way latency should stay under 150 ms.

items.q: What does the E911 data sheet say you dial?
items.a: 911 directly, with no prefix, and a dispatchable location. The partner named is RedSky.

items.q: What does MyE911 history show an org admin?
items.a: Time, user, number, location, recording, and the SIP invite.

items.q: Is a campaign-profile ANI the same as Certified Caller?
items.a: No. Certified Caller is the STIR/SHAKEN program associated with FCC and CRTC.

items.q: What is on the WEM product page?
items.a: Workforce management, quality, analytics, surveys, recording, and a Verint partnership.

items.q: Does this lab name GenAI Studio's default model?
items.a: No. The page describes an engine-agnostic studio and names Agent Assist summaries as an early consumer.

items.q: What credential will you not invent?
items.a: An administrator exam code. IVA Sales Certified is a partner sales badge: 5 modules, 20 questions, 80 percent.
